reason: A settings plugin for managing global and project agent rules, including editing AGENTS.md files and using an LLM to split rules into layered instruction and skill files before applying changes.

summaries.zh: 用于在设置中编辑全局和项目 AGENTS.md 规则，并通过预览和备份将规则拆分为分层指令与技能文件。
summaries.en: A settings plugin for editing global and project AGENTS.md rules and previewing, backing up, and applying LLM-generated layered instruction and skill files.

capabilities: Read and edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md file
Read and edit AGENTS.md files in selected workspaces and subdirectories
List workspaces, models, and rule files
Invoke an LLM to split project rules into layered AGENTS.md and SKILL.md files
Preview generated changes and apply them with backups before overwriting
